name: Grumman American GA-7 Cougar
summary: Short-lived four-seat twin built in 1978–79, a twin-engine development of the AA-5 with only about 115 produced.

wings: Low, straight wing with rounded tips
engines: Two Lycoming engines in slim nacelles
fuselage: Sleek, rounded four-seat cabin with a wraparound windshield
tail: Swept fin with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Smooth, rounded light twin with a wraparound windshield
Slim nacelles on a straight low wing with plain tips
Swept fin with a low horizontal tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The AA-1/AA-5 is a single-engine airplane with a sliding canopy; the Cougar has an engine on each wing and a side door.
The Twin Comanche has a straight wing and a squared-off, raked fin; the Cougar has a smooth rounded body with a swept fin.
The Duchess has a T-tail; the Cougar has a conventional low tail.
